method.method_draft: Algebraic route: From the text, A(1,4) lies on y=m/x, so m=4. Since B has x=4 and also lies on y=m/x, n=4/4=1, so B=(4,1). The line y=kx+b passes through A(1,4) and B(4,1), so its slope is (1-4)/(4-1)=-1 and its equation is y=-x+5. Substitute into the inequality: -x+5-4/x>0. Because the domain is x>0, multiply by x without changing the inequality direction: -x^2+5x-4>0, equivalently (x-1)(x-4)<0. Hence 1<x<4.
